subject.title: Feature/Fix: Integrate lineage discovery and shadow accounting

question: Is the changed-corpus latency cost of running the non-authoritative lineage shadow pass acceptable in this intermediate stack slice?
rationale: Tests establish the accounting behavior and the latest commit avoids redundant unchanged-corpus scans, but maintainer intent is needed to accept the temporary runtime cost before the later optimization slice lands.

options.title: Require exact-head proof
options.body: Keep this PR open until redacted cold-refresh and unchanged-corpus repeat logs from this head demonstrate acceptable latency and no repeated lineage parsing.

options.title: Accept temporary stack cost
options.body: Merge after https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 with an explicit decision to accept changed-corpus shadow-scan overhead until the later optimization slice lands.

options.title: Land with optimization slice
options.body: Avoid exposing the intermediate cost by landing this behavior together with the performance work in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2158.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open until redacted cold-refresh and unchanged-corpus repeat logs from this head demonstrate acceptable latency and no repeated lineage parsing.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining question is repository-level acceptance of an intermediate scanner availability tradeoff and merge sequence.
